process: A person is sketching an apple in pencil on a large sheet of paper, building up its outline and then its shading.

stages.prompt: An overhead view over the shoulder of a person in a dark sweater drawing with a pencil on a large white sheet of paper clipped to a board. A pencil sketch of an apple, with a faint outline and a few light hatching lines, sits in the lower middle of the paper. A real red apple rests on the table above the sheet, and a clear box of drawing tools sits at the right.

An overhead view over the shoulder of a person in a dark sweater drawing with a pencil on a large white sheet of paper clipped to a board. The pencil apple now has darker shading down its left side and a stem drawn at the top, and the pencil rests at its lower right. A real red apple rests on the table above the sheet, and a clear box of drawing tools sits at the right.

An overhead view over the shoulder of a person in a dark sweater drawing with a pencil on a large white sheet of paper clipped to a board. The pencil apple is now shaded across its lower half with dense hatching, and faint shading starts on the paper beneath it. A real red apple rests on the table above the sheet, and a clear box of drawing tools sits at the right.

stages.state: apple shaded with cast shadow beneath
stages.prompt: An overhead view over the shoulder of a person in a dark sweater drawing with a pencil on a large white sheet of paper clipped to a board. The pencil apple is shaded over most of its body, with a soft grey cast shadow drawn beneath it on the paper. A real red apple rests on the table above the sheet, and a clear box of drawing tools sits at the right.
